description: Canonical TAP capability registry — the platform's public authorization vocabulary (e.g. 'grid.read'). This file is the source of truth: tap_auth/capabilities.py loads and validates it, and tap_auth/sync.py hard-syncs the Capability table + projected Django permissions to match it exactly. Capabilities are operation-level (not model-level) in v1; runtime checks resolve them by public name and fail closed on an unknown one. Edit here (reviewed in git) to add or retire a capability — removal must be an explicitly declared prune at sync time, never silent. Risk metadata is DB-queryable so a future AI/Paladin actor can reason about how dangerous an action is without code access. Role-to-capability bundles live in tap_auth.roles.json, not here. See spec-tap-auth-v0 req-tap-auth-capabilities.

capabilities.name: grid.read
capabilities.description: Read TAP graph nodes and edges.

capabilities.name: grid.discover
capabilities.description: Introspect the grid's type/schema catalog (list and describe node/edge types and service capabilities) — reads the registry, not graph data. Strictly less sensitive than grid.read. Granted to tap_admin via '*'; deliberately NOT yet on grid.read-holding roles (tap_viewer et al.) because v0 has no non-admin discovery consumer — relax on demand when a schema/AI surface needs it.

capabilities.name: grid.write
capabilities.description: Create or update TAP graph nodes and edges.

capabilities.name: grid.delete
capabilities.description: Delete (tombstone) TAP graph nodes and edges.

capabilities.name: grid.reconcile
capabilities.description: Reconcile a collection run: judge its retirement candidates and apply the verdicts (tombstone, rename, end an ownership edge) through the service layer. Held by the tap_cares.collector program actor so the run's final phase can act; the per-collector reconcile_authority switch, off by default, is the operator's control. Distinct from grid.delete: a collector never deletes, the reconcile verb does, on evidence (req-grid-reconcile-verb).

capabilities.name: grid.import_grift
capabilities.description: Import a GRIFT batch into the grid.

capabilities.name: grid.admin
capabilities.description: Administer grid-level types and configuration.

capabilities.name: grid.purge
capabilities.description: Irreversibly hard-delete graph data (DEBUG-gated; destroys history).

capabilities.name: auth.manage_users
capabilities.description: Create, modify, deactivate, and manage user/actor accounts.

capabilities.name: auth.manage_sessions
capabilities.description: Invalidate active login sessions (global / per-user / per-session) — the incident-response banhammer. Separable from user management so an IR role can hold it without full account control.

capabilities.name: auth.manage_providers
capabilities.description: Configure authentication providers and identity settings.

capabilities.name: config.manage
capabilities.description: Manage instance configuration and settings.

capabilities.name: plugins.read
capabilities.description: Read the plugin registry/report — installed plugins, versions, sources, install mode, declared vs loaded surfaces, load health, and cross-plugin dependency edges (the instance's plugin software bill of materials). Read-only inspection; the read half of plugins.manage.

capabilities.name: plugins.manage
capabilities.description: Install, enable, disable, or configure plugins.

capabilities.name: cares.run_collectors
capabilities.description: Run collectors and ingestion jobs.

capabilities.name: cares.self_test_collectors
capabilities.description: Run a collector's read-only readiness self-test (no grid write). Strictly less privileged than cares.run_collectors — a caller may probe a collector's health without being able to trigger a run that writes CollectionJob rows.

capabilities.name: cares.manage_schedules
capabilities.description: Create schedules and their SCHEDULED_TARGET edges (structural changes to WHEN a collector runs). Deliberately separate from cares.toggle_schedules — creating new automation is a higher bar than pausing existing automation.

capabilities.name: cares.toggle_schedules
capabilities.description: Enable or disable an existing schedule (pause/resume). The operational 'banhammer' for a runaway schedule — deliberately separable from cares.manage_schedules (mirrors auth.manage_sessions vs auth.manage_users) so an incident-response actor can pause automation without being able to create it.

capabilities.name: cares.run_scheduler
capabilities.description: Advance the scheduler: evaluate the current minute slot and fire due schedules (creates ScheduleFire nodes and triggers collection runs). The scheduler heartbeat capability, held by the tap_cares.scheduler program actor; distinct from managing schedules.

capabilities.name: cares.reconcile_collectors
capabilities.description: Materialize on-grid Collector nodes from the in-memory collector registry (the deferred grid-side half of dual-existence registration). Held by the boot orchestrator's tap_bootloader; distinct from running collectors.

capabilities.name: ai.delegate
capabilities.description: Delegate bounded authority to AI actors acting on a user's behalf.
